content.text: do you have access to tool call history beyond this chat?

I do have filesystem access, so I could inspect locally saved session logs if they exist. Codex supports saved local history, per the [official OpenAI documentation](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/config-file/config-reference). I haven’t checked your logs.
